title: The Slow Orbit
author: Yara Nystrom
blurb: Wren Dravenmoor, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, has spent five years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
